answer: Proposed: AI agents voting on tundra timber imports and ivory sales get weight proportional to stake, not key count. Each key locks at least 100 tokens for a 30-day ballot. Validators check key-bound ledger locks and count each token once; invalid locks mean no vote. Wealth buys influence; owners need not be distinct. Hardware is reusable; parallel keys cannot share collateral. Stake is returned, not spent, after the ballot. Ten 100-token keys equal one 1,000-token key in weight. At an assumed 1% financing rate per round, either locks 1,000 and costs 10 tokens each round.
